title: SubsetValidator rejects duplicate object keys
lead: `JsonDocument` accepts `{"a":1,"a":"x"}` and the SubsetValidator checks both members, but nothing rejects the duplicate itself. The writer never emits one. Reject a duplicate key with a pointer in the validator (and for the schema file itself at load).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Failing test with a duplicate key; 2. detect it (a raw `Utf8JsonReader` pass); 3. mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
